heading_path.h3: Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids

record.evidence_quote: ### Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids 3. The prism shown below is a cuboid. The height of the cuboid is 6 metres, the length is 12 metres and the breadth is 5 metres. Find the volume of the prism.
record.prompt_text:
### Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids

3. The prism shown below is a cuboid. The height of the cuboid is 6 metres, the length is 12 metres and the breadth is 5 metres. Find the volume of the prism.
record.answer_text:
The volume of any prism is $\text{V = area of base} \times \text{height of prism}$. A cuboid is a prism with a rectangle as its base.

$$
\begin{array}{ll}
V_{\text{cuboid}} & {= \text{area of base} \times \text{height}} \\
 & {= l_{\text{purple rectangle}} \times b_{\text{purple rectangle}}\times h} \\
 & {= \text{12} \times \text{5} \times \text{6}} \\
 & {= \text{360}\ {\text{m}^{3}}} \\
\end{array}
$$

The volume of the cuboid is 360 m$^{3}$.

heading_path.h3: Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids

record.evidence_quote: ### Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids 4. The prism shown below is a cuboid. The height of the cuboid is 8 cm; the length and breadth are 10 cm and 4 cm respectively. Determine the volume of the cuboid.
record.prompt_text:
### Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids

4. The prism shown below is a cuboid. The height of the cuboid is 8 cm; the length and breadth are 10 cm and 4 cm respectively. Determine the volume of the cuboid.
record.answer_text:
$$
\begin{array}{ll}
V_{\text{cuboid}} & {= l_{\text{purple rectangle}} \times b_{\text{purple rectangle}} \times h} \\
 & {= \text{10} \times \text{4} \times \text{8}} \\
 & {= \text{320}\ {\text{cm}^{3}}} \\
\end{array}
$$

The volume of the cuboid is 320 cm$^{3}$.
